statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service was to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms
The service was to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The submitted clinical indication note documents these symptoms and the rationale for this diagnostic procedure
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
